title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six
text:
Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six is a first-person shooter computer game and the first in the Rainbow Six series. It was developed and published by Red Storm Entertainment for Windows in 1998. It was later ported to Mac OS, Nintendo 64, PlayStation, Sega Dreamcast and Game Boy Color. An expansion pack, Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Mission Pack: Eagle Watch, was released on January 31, 1999
